import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,sys,json
for page in [11,16]:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1300','-singlefile','-png','inputs/sources/sierpinski.pdf'],capture_output=True,check=True)
 name=f'pdf-page-{page}.png'
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',name,'--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(z.stdout),capture_output=True,check=True)
 print('PNG:'+base64.b64encode(z.stdout).decode())
